paper.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition

result.summary: 本文提出深度残差学习框架，将堆叠层改为学习相对于输入的残差映射，以缓解深层网络训练困难的问题 [S1.p5]。作者在 ImageNet 上验证了极深残差网络易于优化，并能从深度增加中获得精度提升 [S1.p7]。152 层残差网络是当时 ImageNet 上最深网络，复杂度仍低于 VGG，集成模型在测试集上取得 3.57% top-5 错误率并赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名 [S1.p9]。作者还在 CIFAR-10 上分析了 100 层和 1000 层网络 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：随着网络加深，训练误差反而升高（退化问题），而这一问题并非由梯度消失/爆炸导致 [S1.p2][S1.p5]。作者指出深度对图像分类至关重要，但简单堆叠更多层并不一定更容易学到更好的网络 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: Recent evidence reveals that network depth is of crucial importance
Is learning better networks as easy as stacking more layers?
An obstacle to answering this question was the notorious problem of vanishing/exploding gradients
In this paper, we address the degradation problem by introducing a deep residual learning framework.

method.text: 论文提出残差学习框架：不要求堆叠层直接拟合目标映射 H(x)，而是让它们拟合残差映射 F(x):=H(x)-x，原始映射变为 F(x)+x [S1.p5]。作者假设优化残差映射比优化原始无参考映射更容易，极端情况下若恒等映射最优，将残差推向零比用非线性层拟合恒等映射更容易 [S1.p5]。在实现上，ImageNet 模型采用批归一化、SGD、mini-batch 256、学习率从 0.1 开始并在误差平台时除以 10 等设置 [S3.SS4.p1]。

evidence.quote: we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping
We hypothesize that it is easier to optimize the residual mapping than to optimize the original, unreferenced mapping.
it would be easier to push the residual to zero than to fit an identity mapping by a stack of nonlinear layers
We adopt batch normalization (BN) right after each convolution and before activation
We use SGD with a mini-batch size of 256.

experiments.text: 论文在 ImageNet 2012 分类数据集上评估，该数据集包含 1000 类、128 万训练图像、5 万验证图像和 10 万测试图像，报告 top-1 和 top-5 错误率 [S4.SS1.p1]。作者还使用 CIFAR-10 数据集（5 万训练图像、1 万测试图像、10 类）研究极深网络行为 [S4.SS2.p1]。此外，论文在 PASCAL VOC 2007/2012 和 MS COCO 上采用 Faster R-CNN 进行目标检测评估，比较用 ResNet-101 替换 VGG-16 的改进 [S4.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: We evaluate our method on the ImageNet 2012 classification dataset that consists of 1000 classes.
The models are trained on the 1.28 million training images, and evaluated on the 50k validation images.
We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes.
We adopt Faster R-CNN as the detection method.
Here we are interested in the improvements of replacing VGG-16 with ResNet-101.

findings.text: 在 ImageNet 上，34 层 ResNet 比 18 层 ResNet 好 2.8%，且 34 层 ResNet 比对应的普通网络降低 top-1 错误率 3.5% [S4.SS1.p6][S4.SS1.p7]。50/101/152 层 ResNet 比 34 层更准确，未观察到退化问题，并从深度增加中获得显著精度提升 [S4.SS1.p15]。152 层 ResNet 单模型 top-5 验证错误率为 4.49%，超过此前所有集成结果；六模型集成在测试集上达到 3.57% top-5 错误率，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。在 CIFAR-10 上，ResNet 同样克服优化困难并在深度增加时获得精度提升 [S4.SS2.p5]。在 COCO 检测上，ResNet-101 相比 VGG-16 在 mAP@[.5,.95] 上提升 6.0%，相对提升 28% [S4.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: the 34-layer ResNet is better than the 18-layer ResNet (by 2.8%)
the 34-layer ResNet reduces the top-1 error by 3.5%
The 50/101/152-layer ResNets are more accurate than the 34-layer ones by considerable margins
Our 152-layer ResNet has a single-model top-5 validation error of 4.49%.
This leads to 3.57% top-5 error on the test set
our ResNets manage to overcome the optimization difficulty and demonstrate accuracy gains when the depth increases
we obtain a 6.0% increase in COCO’s standard metric (mAP@[.5,.95]), which is a 28% relative improvement

limitations.text: 作者指出，1202 层网络在 CIFAR-10 上的测试结果比 110 层网络更差，尽管两者训练误差相近，作者认为这是因为过拟合，且该网络对此小数据集可能过大 [S4.SS2.p9]。作者在 CIFAR-10 上未使用 maxout/dropout，仅通过深而窄的架构施加正则化，并指出结合更强正则化可能改善结果，留待未来研究 [S4.SS2.p9]。对于深层普通网络优化困难的原因，作者表示将在未来研究 [S4.SS1.p4]。

evidence.quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error.
We argue that this is because of overfitting.
The 1202-layer network may be unnecessarily large (19.4M) for this small dataset.
But combining with stronger regularization may improve results, which we will study in the future.
The reason for such optimization difficulties will be studied in the future.
